verdict.rationale: The pack never documents replacing or restyling an element inside an existing video while preserving the rest of the frame. The mask-based local re-editing that preserves unmodified regions is scoped to Image 3.0 Omni, which is an image feature, not video. The pricing line for video generation with video input and the generic mention of refining and editing videos do not describe localized element replacement, so neither transfers to this story.
